notes.title: Legends of Crystal
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359227/eb3ed07ff6c590186477cd7984663237e5c550e2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41359227/4fd9935a5f0cc29606b4a49c352079eeeccf1045.jpg[/img][/url]

In the past, the insatiable greed of jinns and mythical creatures led to the splitting of the crystal into six parts, dispersing them to all corners of the world.

Manipulation, provocation, and incitement are tactics consistently employed by jinns to reclaim the entirety of the crystal's power.

In the medieval era, a child chosen by the gods possesses a unique talent. Utilize these abilities to rescue the crystal from malevolence and avert the world's impending destruction.
